summary: Iteration 34: Tested Scheme of Work module - a dual-sided workspace for Staff (teachers) and Management (admins). Fixed critical MongoDB _id serialization bug in create/upload endpoints. All 20 backend tests PASSED. All frontend features verified via Playwright.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/schemes/my-dashboard returns staff stats (total, term_schemes, drafts, submitted, returned, approved)
Backend: GET /api/schemes/ lists teacher's own schemes
Backend: POST /api/schemes/ creates new scheme with draft status
Backend: GET /api/schemes/{id} returns scheme with comments and audit_trail
Backend: PUT /api/schemes/{id} updates scheme content and changes status to in_progress
Backend: POST /api/schemes/{id}/submit submits scheme to management
Backend: POST /api/schemes/{id}/withdraw withdraws submitted scheme
Backend: GET /api/schemes/management-dashboard returns management stats
Backend: GET /api/schemes/management-dashboard returns 403 for teacher
Backend: GET /api/schemes/?status=all_submitted lists all non-draft schemes for management
Backend: POST /api/schemes/{id}/review with action=start_review changes status to under_review
Backend: POST /api/schemes/{id}/review with action=approve changes status to approved
Backend: POST /api/schemes/{id}/review with action=return changes status to returned
Backend: GET /api/schemes/management/compliance returns teacher compliance data
Backend: GET /api/schemes/management/compliance returns 403 for teacher
Backend: POST /api/schemes/{id}/comments adds comment to scheme
Backend: DELETE /api/schemes/{id} deletes draft scheme
Backend: DELETE /api/schemes/{id} returns 400 for approved scheme
Backend: POST /api/schemes/upload creates scheme with file_id
Frontend Staff: Dashboard shows stats cards (Total, This Term, Drafts, Submitted, Returned, Approved)
Frontend Staff: Create New and Upload buttons visible
Frontend Staff: Filter buttons (All, Drafts, Pending, Returned, Approved) work
Frontend Staff: Create scheme form with title, subject, year group, term, curriculum, department
Frontend Staff: Scheme editor with rich text editor, tabs (Editor, Comments, History)
Frontend Staff: AI Assistant panel with 7 AI action buttons + custom command
Frontend Staff: Save, Submit, Delete buttons in editor
Frontend Management: Dashboard shows stats (Total Submitted, Pending Review, Under Review, Approved, Returned)
Frontend Management: Tabs (Submissions, Compliance Tracker, Overdue Staff) work
Frontend Management: Submissions table with Staff, Subject/Class, Term, Status, Submitted, AI, Action columns
Frontend Management: Compliance Tracker shows teacher compliance with progress bars
Frontend Management: Overdue Staff shows teachers who haven't submitted
Frontend Management: Review panel shows scheme content, comments, audit trail
Frontend Management: Approve/Return/Publish buttons in review panel
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: MongoDB _id serialization bug - insert_one() adds _id to doc dict, causing JSON serialization error. Fixed by calling doc.pop('_id', None) before returning
FIXED: Duplicate key error - removed _id: None from insert_one() calls which caused E11000 duplicate key errors
FIXED: Removed unnecessary update_many() calls to unset _id after insert
updated_files: /app/backend/routes/schemes.py (fixed _id handling in create_scheme, upload_scheme, log_scheme_action, add_comment, review_scheme)
seed_data_creation: Test schemes created and cleaned up during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 34 tested the new Scheme of Work module. Key data-testids: scheme-staff-view, scheme-mgmt-view, create-scheme-btn, upload-scheme-btn, scheme-title-input, scheme-subject, submit-create-scheme, scheme-editor, toggle-ai, ai-panel, ai-improve, ai-standardise, ai-expand, ai-objectives, ai-assessment, ai-gaps, ai-digitalize, ai-custom, save-scheme, submit-scheme, back-from-editor, mgmt-search, mgmt-review-panel, review-comment, start-review, approve-scheme, return-scheme, publish-scheme. Status flow: draft -> in_progress -> submitted -> under_review -> approved/returned -> published. AI integration uses emergentintegrations with gemini-2.0-flash.

bugs_fixed.description: MongoDB _id serialization error - ObjectId not JSON serializable
bugs_fixed.fix: Added doc.pop('_id', None) after insert_one() to remove MongoDB-added _id before returning

bugs_fixed.description: E11000 duplicate key error on _id: null
bugs_fixed.fix: Removed _id: None from insert_one() calls and removed unnecessary update_many() to unset _id
